subject: Request: calibration window & temporary measurement adjustment for hosted p50/p95
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@ellara.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 09:24 -0700
Subject: Request: calibration window & temporary measurement adjustment for hosted p50/p95

Hi Sara —

Following our incident review yesterday I wanted to propose a short, targeted operational change to how we count p95 for Ellara traffic on the Hosted API while we complete the observability fixes on our side. In short:

- What we saw: transient instrumentation jitter from the metrics agent during a multi-region rollout produced a cluster of high tail samples concentrated in a 12-hour burst on 2026-06-13. Those samples are inflating your p95 for that day despite end-to-end latency at the application layer staying within normal bounds.
- Proposal: allow a seven-day calibration window during which we will exclude the identified instrumented traces from contract measurement for p95 only, while continuing to surface raw metrics for transparency. After the window we will recompute the rolling p95 and share before/after numbers.
- Controls: we will (1) publish the exact trace ids and timestamps, (2) grant read-only access to the recalculation sheet, and (3) retain all original logs for audit.
- Risk/impact: this affects only the SLO measurement for p95 (not p50); it is a temporary carveout tied to a documented instrumentation bug, not a permanent SLA change.

I've attached a short runbook and sample traces. If you agree, we'll formalize with a one-paragraph addendum to the SLA that references the calibration window and the audit artifacts.

Requesting your sign-off by EOD Tuesday so we can commence the recalculation and deploy the observability patch (ETA 72 hours).

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_calibration_runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: p95-sample-traces.csv (csv)]

From: Sara Lim <sara@ellara.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellara Systems <ops@ellara.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 10:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: calibration window & temporary measurement adjustment for hosted p50/p95

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear write-up and attachments. I appreciate that youre keeping the raw metrics visible. A few quick items from our side:

- We need the exact list of trace ids before any recalculation; ops will keep an independent copy.
- Seven days seems reasonable if you commit to the 72-hour patch and the post-calibration report.
- Legal will want a one-sentence reference in the SLA addendum that the carveout is limited to documented instrumentation events and includes audit support.

Please go ahead with the recalculation once Karthik/your team confirms the trace set. I will loop in procurement if we need a formal amendment.

—Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Platform Engineering, Ellara Systems
[Attachment: ops-ack.png (png)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara@ellara.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 14:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: calibration window & temporary measurement adjustment for hosted p50/p95

+1 on approach. A couple of technical clarifications from the runtime/metrics side:

- The instrumentation bug is limited to the client-side metrics aggregator that stamps the "end_to_end_ms" metric when requests are proxied across region pairs during our rollout. We have a diagnostics flag to identify those records; we will export them as a separate CSV and mark them in the recalculation script.
- Recalculation plan: run script locally against archived metrics -> produce two artifacts (recomputed sliding p95 time series and a differential report). We'll store both artifacts in the shared Drive link.
- Observability fix: patch will be deployed to canary by 2026-06-15 03:00 UTC and promoted by 2026-06-16 00:00 UTC pending regression checks.

Jonas, once you confirm Sara has the trace id list we will kick off the recalculation. Ill also attach a small CSV with sample traces for her team to cross-validate.

Karthik
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: p95-calibration-sample.csv (csv)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara@ellara.com>
Date: 2026-06-15 09:08 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: calibration window & temporary measurement adjustment for hosted p50/p95

Forwarding with a legal note:

On internal review this is acceptable as a limited operational carveout provided we (1) document the exact traces and timestamps, (2) limit the scope to the single identified instrumentation event cluster, and (3) include an explicit expiration date for the carveout in the addendum.

Suggested SLA addendum wording (one sentence to include in the existing SLA appendix):
"Redwood may exclude from contractual p95 calculations any latency samples demonstrably caused by instrumentation or telemetry errors, subject to a documented calibration window, shared audit artifacts, and a mutual sign-off from both parties."

If Ellara agrees, legal is fine with a short e-sign amendment; procurement can route it via DocuSign.

—Lauren
Director, Contracts & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@ellara.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16 17:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: calibration window & temporary measurement adjustment for hosted p50/p95

Sara —

Thanks for the prompt feedback and for confirming. Per the thread:

- Karthik's team has produced the trace id CSV (attached) and will start the recalculation this evening.
- Observability patch is in canary and on track for promotion by 2026-06-16 UTC.
- Lauren's suggested addendum wording looks good; we'll draft a 1-paragraph amendment and route for e-sign.

Next steps:
1) Karthik to create the recalculation artifacts and drop them in the shared Drive link (Ive included the Drive url in related_links).
2) Jonas to share the drafted amendment with Sara and procurement by 2026-06-17 10:00 PDT.
3) Both sides to confirm the recalculated p95 and close the window after seven days of post-patch observation.

Attaching the runbook and the sample traces again for visibility.

Appreciate the quick collaboration — well keep the audit trail intact.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
